_doc: Technology data of v8 (2026-11-11). One cost rule for every technology: annual cost = overnight capex (development and grid connection included, contingency and subsidies excluded) x interest during construction (build_y, real rate) x CRF(real rate, life) + fixed O&M. Real 2025 euros, costs of plants contracted or built in 2024-2026, no learning to 2040 except in the 'target' cases of technologies without commercial plants. Sources: docs/audit/v8_symmetric_costs.md (with URLs) and docs/audit/audit_v8_findings.md. Auction prices (FER-X, MACSE) are NOT used as costs.

global.src: grid_thr_total_GW: 137 GW is the TOTAL wind+PV stock that the Terna plan enables (43 existing + 94), so the existing fleet kept in the model is subtracted (v7 bug: only new blocks were counted). peak_ref_step: the reserve requirement uses the peak of the 3-hour data at every time step (v7 used the peak of the step-averaged load: 64.7/67.0/76.9 GW at 12/6/3 h). Grid charge 13 (PV) and 8 (wind) EUR/MWh at 1,066 and 1,709 h = 245 EUR/kW over 40 years (Terna: 23 bn EUR for 94 GW), transmission only; it now follows the discount rate.

disp.name: NUC
disp.src: Central case = Dukovany 5-6 as in the Czech notification to the European Commission (SA.117794, OJ C/2026/2825, 27 May 2026). Capex per NET kW: EPC 407 bn CZK + state preparation and owner's costs 85 bn CZK (CT24, 13 Oct 2025) = 492 bn CZK / 24.688 CZK/EUR (ECB 2025 average) = 19.93 bn EUR for 2 x 976 MWe (recital 40) = 10,210 EUR/kW, rounded 10,200; fuel contract (separate, 15-20 bn CZK) and contingency excluded. Official overnight bracket EUR [20-25] bn including fuel and contingency = 9,890-12,450 EUR/kW net without fuel. Construction 9 years and operating life 60 years as in the Czech financial model (recital 89). OPEX: midpoint 40 EUR/MWh of the official range [35-45] (recital 95; fixed O&M, lifecycle investment, fuel, waste account, decommissioning): variable 12.25 = fuel 7.5 + marginal 4.75 (midpoints of recital 96), fixed 27.75 EUR/MWh at 90% load factor. Availability: mean 0.90 (15.4 TWh on 1,952 MW, recital 41) through nuc.av_scale. Cases: 'v7' restores the superseded v7 inputs.

disp.name: IMPORT

Import price 115.94 EUR/MWh (PUN 2025, GME). Exports: capacity 6,095/11,535 of the import capacity (Terna 2025 export and import limits), revenue 61.07 EUR/MWh (France 2025 day-ahead average, GME/RTE), variants 0 and 115.94. New lines: capex as v7 with interest during construction (4 y, assumption) and O&M 1.5%/yr (proxy, assumption). | v7 note: existing 11.535 GW (ARERA 366/2025); blocks Terna/ARERA (v7_storage_flex.md sez.8.2); total new 7.33 GW = Terna 2040 need (Nord 4.38 + Est 1.85 + Nord Africa 1.10). Price: PUN 2025 average 115.94 EUR/MWh (GME), varied x0.5 and x1.5. Credit 38% = 4.4/11.5 (capacity market 2025). No export modelled. disp.name: CSP
disp.src: Yield: Andasol 1-3 (50 MW, 7.5 h storage, DNI 2136) guaranteed net 165 GWh/yr = 3307 h/MW (Dinter, Operation experience, SolarPACES/SASEC; observed annual output not found), scaled linearly by DNI 1875 (middle of 1800-1950 for Sicily, given by the coordinator, not measured by us) = 2903, rounded 2900. ENEA 2026 4100 MWh/MW at Priolo is a simulation for a 1 MW plant with 50000 m2 per MW (81.5 kWh/m2), solar multiple not stated: not used. Capex first plant: Andasol 1 EUR 310 M for 49.9 MW (2008), SolarPACES USD 10618.6/kW in 2020 USD / 1.1188 = 9491 EUR/kW (only European plant with a published cost and 7.5 h storage; recent Spanish plants such as Solgest-1 do not publish cost); target: IRENA 2024 world average 3677 USD/kW / 1.1188 = 3287 EUR/kW. Credit: mean over the top 1% load steps of min(1, daily budget on that day / 4 h) with the daily budget from the national PV profile; 10 GW is OUR ceiling (not sourced); sensitivity 3 GW (c3). | v8: target capex is the IRENA 2024 world average, driven by Chinese plants (not Andasol); 3 years of construction added.

stor.name: BATT
stor.src: ARERA 332/2026/R/eel (24 Sep 2026, second MACSE auction): 4-hour lithium system 150.5 EUR per usable kWh (battery 72, power electronics 15, EPC 46.5, external and connection 17) x 1.12 oversizing against degradation = 168.6; O&M 4.486 EUR/kWh-yr; life 15 y; construction 2 y. Round-trip efficiency 85% (Terna study, ARERA 168/2025). The MACSE 2025 award price (12,959 EUR/MWh-yr, implied about 95 EUR/kWh) is NOT used: analysts report bids relying on post-contract revenues and low returns. credit_dur 6.6: capacity credit = power x 4/6.6, i.e. the same adequacy contribution per kWh as in v7 (assumption).

pv.src: EUR/kWp. Ground (single-axis tracker, 10-30 MW, development, connection and land included): 950 (PoliMi Renewable Energy Report 2025: 900-1,000 at 30 MW, 1,000-1,100 at 10 MW; Italia Solare Oct 2025: 1,000 at 1 MW). Agrivoltaic 30 MW: 1,200 (PoliMi 1,100-1,300). Industrial roofs: 950 = mean of GSE for ARERA 239/2025 (850, 0.2-1 MW) and PoliMi (1,000-1,100 at 500 kW). Other roofs: 1,250 = mean of GSE (1,100 up to 200 kW) and IEA PVPS Italy 2024 (1,400 residential). O&M 20 EUR/kWp-yr (GSE). Life 25 y (PoliMi; GSE 20, Fraunhofer 30). Degradation 0.5%/yr (Fraunhofer assumes 0.25, observed US fleet median 0.75): mean output over the life = 0.94 of year 1. Build 1 y (assumption). yield_mult 1.12 on ground and agrivoltaic blocks: tracker yield over the fixed-tilt PECD yield of the model (developer P50 in MASE filings: Puglia 1,596-1,712 kWh/kWp against 1,462 in the model). Existing plants: O&M only; yield scaled by 0.857 so that the existing fleet in the model (1,304 h) matches the observed national fleet (GSE 2025: 1,117 h).

on.src: Onshore wind 30 MW: 1,600 EUR/kW (PoliMi 2025: 1,500-1,700; GSE for ARERA 239/2025: 1,580-1,700), O&M 40 EUR/kW-yr (GSE 35-40), life 25 y, build 2 y (assumption). Blocks differ by full-load hours (2,400 to 1,200); existing fleet 13.6 GW at 1,600 h (observed 2025: 1,626 h) pays O&M only.

off.src: Offshore wind at today's estimated costs (none built in Italy): bottom-fixed 3,400 EUR/kW (PoliMi 2025: 3,300-3,500), floating 4,750 EUR/kW (PoliMi 2025: 4,500-5,000; Sapienza/ANEV 2026: 4,850), O&M 80 and 100 EUR/kW-yr (Sapienza/ANEV 2026: 80-127 for floating), life 25 y, build 3 y (assumption). v7 used cost estimates for 2040-2050 with learning (3,200-3,600 EUR/kW) for the block that was built.
